title.sub_en: When Metal Combines With Traditional Craft

works.description: MËWEVE結合了不鏽鋼的現代材質與竹編的傳統工藝，呈現出時尚與自然的和諧融合。利用鋼硬的材料與柔軟的手工編織展現出新穎與傳統結晶。
works.longDescription: 竹編在台灣曾經是很重要的一項產業，卻因為全球暖化加上因為政策的改變，使竹材越來越難獲得，導致竹傢俱逐漸沒落。運用金屬材質呈現竹的工藝去打造新的設計，利用新的材質與舊的工藝去編織出能帶有傳承的作品。將造型設計為立體塊體、錐形，利用傳統幾何編織為主軸，嘗試不同比例的彎折，打造新的編織思維。
works.english: MËWEVE combines the modern material of stainless steel with the traditional craftsmanship of bamboo weaving, presenting a harmonious fusion of fashion and nature. Using hard materials and soft hand-woven fabrics presents a combination of novelty and tradition.
works.english_detail: Bamboo weaving was once vital in Taiwan, but global warming and policy changes have diminished bamboo availability, causing a decline in bamboo furniture.By using metal to emulate bamboo craftsmanship and traditional geometric weaving, new designs are created, blending heritage with modern materials and concepts.
